name: Spacemud
english_description: A Space-themed mudlib built on the LIMA Mudlib codebase (same FluffOS-project reference framework already onboarded standalone as libs/lima) with as few changes to Lima itself as possible, adding real bespoke content and engine extensions: domains/omega and domains/pinto (authored NPCs/items -- lunar_lurker, hyperspace_hoodie, dark_ship, a yakitori delivery guild) plus std/spaceship/ and space_d.lpc/spacestation_d.lpc/ship_d.lpc/proc_gen_d.lpc (procedural star-system generation, ship navigation/docking, spaceship mechanics). check_config.lpc's driver-flag requirements are identical to libs/lima's own (modern fork, #undef ARRAY_RESERVED_WORD) rather than libs/wilderness's older, opposite-flag snapshot, so this lib reuses the existing ~/src/fluffos-lima driver worktree directly with no new worktree needed. Onboarding found two new, previously-uncatalogued bug classes (AGENTS.md #7.166/#7.167): (1) daemons/method_d.lpc and daemons/space_d.lpc both called one of their own check_privilege()-gated mutators directly from create(), which can never succeed on this driver (the check requires a real connected this_user() at the end of the call chain, absent at boot) -- silently broken every boot (masked by secure/master.lpc's preload() catch()), breaking EVERY complex-exit 'go' method mudlib-wide (elevators/doors) and permanently preventing the procedural universe from ever generating; fixed by routing both through unguarded(), the same mechanism M_DAEMON_DATA's own save_me()/restore_me() already use for this exact scenario. (2) daemons/crafting_d.lpc's create() used `materials == ([])` (mapping identity, not value, equality -- confirmed `([]) == ([])` is false on this driver) to decide whether to load its config file, so the config never loaded past the first (broken) boot and EVERY set_salvageable() call mudlib-wide threw 'Invalid salvage type' for every category, not just one -- a severe, corpus-wide breakage of the entire crafting/salvage feature; fixed with the sizeof()-based idiom the rest of the codebase already uses correctly. Also fixed: a bespoke ASCII-frame colour-theme module (std/modules/m_frame.lpc, no stock-Lima equivalent) crashed with 'Array index out of bounds' the first time ANY player using a non-xterm256 client pressed 's'/'r' in the account menu, because explode("", ",") returns a zero-element array on this driver (not a one-element array containing "") and the built-in 'none' colour theme's fields are legitimately empty strings; a stale path reference (school/R/object01+02's set_objects still pointed at the archive's old /domains/std/map before spacemud's own reorg into domains/std/object/); two American/British spelling typos in new yakitori-guild content (ARMOR->ARMOUR, set_armor_class->set_armour_class); a superfluous #include <menu.h> (the header doesn't exist in this fork) blocking two real omega items (control_terminal, communication_panel) and five rooms that clone them; and a call to a never-implemented set_strength_vs_override() (the whole 'override electronics' skill path has no other implementation anywhere in the codebase) removed rather than invented, matching AGENTS.md #7.51's precedent. A residual ~23-file lpcc_check.sh tail (WWW/cgi doc tooling with http_d disabled by default, obj/secure/mailers' missing trim_spaces(), secure/daemons/ftp_d's functional/local-variable driver limitation, contrib/{bboard,marriage,roommaker,transient_effect} incomplete/optional demo content, domains/std/school+room/{caves,labyrinth} unfinished tutorial rooms, and two archived Beavis/Butthead easter-egg NPCs with a genuine pre-existing type bug in std/modules/m_react.lpc) is confirmed byte-identical or structurally identical to libs/lima's OWN already-documented, deliberately-left-unfixed gaps -- not spacemud regressions, left alone per that precedent. Full registration-to-gameplay playthrough verified live: real account registration (gender/email/real name/homepage/referral), character creation (human, both genders), the account menu's select/enter-game flow (including the character-select crash fix), look/score/inventory/who all correct, navigation from the space station's wakeup_room through the maintenance corridors (exercising the method_d fix live), a full get+salvage round-trip in the armour-tutorial room (exercising the crafting_d fix live, correctly yielding copper/lead/steel scrap), and a clean quit back to the account menu. First character auto-granted wizard/admin per Lima's own AUTO_WIZ convention (documented, not a bug). See libs/spacemud/NOTES.md and AGENTS.md #7.166/#7.167 for the full writeup.
